hook.name: RobinhoodMultiPairV4LaunchHook
hook.description: A multi-pair Uniswap v4 launch hook for the Robinhood Chain that atomically initializes and permanently funds up to four trading pairs (RWI, ETH, USDG, PONS) in a single transaction. Uses beforeSwap to match accumulated token-fee inventory against organic buys at the live pool price via a return delta, without moving the pool.
